On 2027-01-01, Florida has the highest minimum wage of these at $15.00 and Ohio the lowest at $11.40, a gap of $3.60 an hour or $7,488.00 a year full time. State-level rates only. City and county minimum wages (for example Seattle, Denver, Chicago, San Francisco) are out of scope and can be higher.
